title: Matched renderer packaging and guarded upgrade recovery
changes: Include the deterministic native renderer and its exact templates in the app image.
Preserve and close retained pre-business verification failures without replay or success claims.
Upload prepared redacted Forms XML with exact matching receipts through a dedicated project path.
Retain immutable redaction provenance and revalidate sources when reading their history.
Review code-unit selection and explicit synthetic-prototype permissions in the project UI.
Queue source-bound prototype work separately from the existing strict native-project workflow.
Negotiate runtime/export adapters without treating exported bytes as full technical or business acceptance.
limitations: Verified checkpoint: local prepared-source intake, assessment and UI. Hosted activation remains pending.
The prototype processing profile and trusted converter/browser adapters require explicit operator configuration.
Real-file OPAF-to-APEX import, authenticated runtime and downloadable export acceptance remain pending.
Technical identifiers are retained; redaction receipts are not complete PII certification or processing permission.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
